title: Western Cider
venue_description:
About Western Cider

Western Cider is a cidery cider apple grower and tasting room located on the banks of the Clark Fork River in Missoula Montana. The dream was seeded in 2012 when co-founder Michael Billingsley planted 2500 cider apple trees in Montana's Bitterroot Valley just south of Missoula. Today they have nearly 5000 trees with over 50 varieties of apples used to produce easy-going and traditional ciders.

Cider Selection

Western Cider crafts quality hard ciders from 100% Northwest Apples including their flagship Poor Farmer Classic. They use apples from their own orchards as well as Northwest orchards to create a variety of cider flavors ranging from traditional to experimental styles.

Tasting Room Experience

The tasting room offers a welcoming community atmosphere with spacious indoor seating and beautiful outdoor areas along the river. Hours are Monday through Thursday 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM Friday and Saturday 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM and Sunday 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM.

Weekly Music & Events

Western Cider is a hub for local music featuring Monday Night Open Mic hosted by Michael Enos starting at 6:00 PM and Old Time Jam sessions on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month at 6:00 PM hosted by Lake Missoula Old Time. All skill levels welcome from beginners to experienced musicians.

Community Events

Beyond music the venue hosts weekly trivia nights on select evenings Sunday morning yoga classes paired with cider and various community gatherings. Private event rentals available for weddings company parties and family celebrations.

Philosophy

As a company Western Cider aspires to create an institution of great cider good times and a life worth living in this far-flung region of the American West. They emphasize community connection local sourcing and quality craftsmanship in everything they do.

title: Imagine Nation Brewing
venue_description:
About Imagine Nation Brewing

Imagine Nation Brewing Company transcends how a brewery serves a community by being the first in the country to include a center for community transformation. Through craft beer and education INBC is a unique model of celebration and dialogue envisioned to joyfully address the challenges of our time and fuel social change in Missoula Montana and beyond.

History & Mission

Founded in 2012 Imagine Nation Brewing was created with the purpose to connect the community through great beer and good conversation. The brewery's logo features a bison - the only animal known to walk towards oncoming storms - symbolizing their vision to approach societal challenges in a celebratory way as a unifying agent of constructive change.

New Location

In April 2025 the taproom moved to their production building at 5646 W Harrier Dr near the Missoula airport. The new Imagine Taproom and Event Center features over 3000 square feet with lovely natural light high ceilings and a beautiful outdoor beer garden with stage.

Craft Beer Excellence

For over 10 years the skilled brewing team has been dedicated to crafting unique and delicious beers that showcase the art of brewing. From hoppy IPAs to complex barrel-aged stouts the beers are designed to inspire and delight. They hand-select the world's finest hops annually and use only premium ingredients including specialty malts.

Live Music Program

Imagine Nation features an active music program including Monday Night Open Mic from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM welcoming songs comedy poetry and spoken word. The new event center with outdoor stage hosts various live performances throughout the week. All ages welcome making it family-friendly.

Community Transformation

INBC collaborates with local organizations hosting fundraisers workshops and meetups. They support inclusive initiatives and provide space for community dialogue and connection. Through commitment to innovative brewing and community engagement they empower individuals to connect grow and make positive impact.

Hours & Visit

Open Thursday through Saturday 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Closed Sunday through Wednesday. The venue serves as a vibrant gathering space where friends and neighbors come together to share in the joy of great beer community and transformation.

title: Flipper's Casino & Tavern
venue_description:
About Flipper's Casino & Tavern

Known by many as the home of Missoula's best burger Flipper's Casino & Tavern has been a beloved neighborhood institution for years. This welcoming establishment combines great food refreshing drinks and entertainment in a warm inviting atmosphere.

Food & Dining

Flipper's is renowned for their exceptional burgers including the famous Chrondo burger with bacon jalapeños and Sriracha the classic Bacon Cheeseburger and Black Bean Burger for vegetarians. The menu also features delicious starters like French Fries Tater Tots Pickle Fries Cheese Fries and Onion Rings all reasonably priced. The pulled pork mac and cheese and chicken sandwiches have also earned rave reviews.

Bar & Beverages

The bar features 13 beers on tap including 9 microbrews with strong emphasis on keeping it local and supporting Montana craft breweries. The original Kettlehouse Amber (formerly Lake Missoula Amber) is exclusively available at Flipper's. Craft cocktails and free drinks while gaming in the casino area. Reasonable prices with beers starting around four dollars.

Music & Entertainment

Flipper's hosts Weekly Open Mic on Tuesday nights from 6:30 PM to 9:30 PM welcoming musicians of all genres and skill levels. Sign-up begins at 6:00 PM. The venue also features occasional live music including jazz performances and local bands throughout the year.

Gaming

Full casino featuring 19 gaming machines thoughtfully spaced for comfortable play. Also includes Golden Tee Golf Live (smoothest trackball in town) and Big Buck Hunter. Free beverages for players.

Atmosphere & Amenities

Spacious interior with plenty of seating options including cozy tavern areas and outdoor patio. Multiple TV screens broadcasting sporting events making it ideal for watching games. Water cooler available for staying hydrated. Located just off the bike path with ample parking. Friendly staff providing quick service in a neighborhood pub atmosphere.

Hours & Location

Open Monday through Saturday 8:00 AM to 2:00 AM and Sunday 10:00 AM to 2:00 AM. Conveniently located at 125 S Third St W in the Riverfront neighborhood near downtown Missoula.

title: The Old Post Pub
venue_description:
About The Old Post Pub

Located in the heart of downtown Missoula The Old Post Pub has been a favorite destination for fantastic food and refreshing cocktails for over 30 years. After closing unexpectedly in 2019 the pub reopened in December 2020 under new ownership by Kimberly and Tom Durham committed to keeping this traditional Missoula establishment alive and thriving.

Renovation & Rebirth

The Durham family along with general manager Rob Evanger completed an intensive interior remodel bringing new life to the historic space while preserving its character. Original Levi Strauss advertisements line the walls and vintage Old Post signage decorates the interior creating warm inviting atmosphere.

Live Music Program

The Old Post features an exceptional weekly live music schedule. Monday Night Bluegrass Jam kicks off around 5:30 PM welcoming pickers and grinners of all levels. Thursday Night Jazz runs 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM featuring Chuck Florence David Horgan and Beth Lo. The small stage creates intimate performance atmosphere perfect for acoustic music. Various other live performances scheduled throughout the week.

Food Excellence

The menu features scratch-made meals crafted with care. Signature items include the famous Drunken Goat Salad with fried goat cheese balls mixed greens toasted almonds roasted bell peppers crumbled bacon and sweet bourbon dressing. The Buttermilk Honey Fried Chicken Sandwich with seared pineapple is made from scratch. Exceptional burgers using local grass-fed beef with premium bacon. Crab cakes Chicken Jambalaya and Chicken-Fried Pork Chop are customer favorites. The Bar 47 Nachos Fish Tacos and classic French Dip complete the diverse menu.

Bar & Cocktails

Full bar featuring craft cocktails and fine selection of Montana brewed craft beers. The Old Post emphasizes quality ingredients and expert mixology in all their drink offerings.

Community Hub

Beyond food and music The Old Post serves as gathering place for the Missoula community. Weekly Trivia Tuesday nights at 7:00 PM bring friends together for brain-teasing competition. The venue welcomes families students locals and visitors creating diverse inclusive atmosphere.

Hours & Service

Open daily Monday through Sunday 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Serving breakfast lunch and dinner with weekend brunch. Friendly knowledgeable staff provide excellent service in comfortable setting. Located at 103 W Spruce Street in downtown Missoula.

title: The Trough
venue_description:
About The Trough

The Trough opened in June 2015 as part of The Olde Dairy and The Trough complex bringing a community-oriented restaurant and market to the Target Range neighborhood. This converted historic dairy building has been beautifully renovated into a modern gathering space while maintaining rustic charm.

Community Mission

With the community in mind The Trough was created to serve the neighborhood. The venue prides itself on being here for neighbors offering versatile space for everything from casual coffee by the fireplace to dinner on the patio to private events and catering.

Dining Experience

The Trough offers variety of lunch and dinner options plus brunch on Saturdays and Sundays. The menu features scratch-made favorites including Pulled Pork Mac and Cheese described as the best dish many customers have had Salmon Sandwich perfectly cooked Crispy Steak Fries loaded with toppings and weekend brunch specialties. Everything is prepared fresh with emphasis on quality and flavor.

Atmosphere

The space features cozy indoor seating with fireplace creating warm inviting environment perfect for meeting friends or taking break from work. The beautiful outdoor patio provides al fresco dining during warmer months. The rustic modern design with natural light creates vacation-from-work feeling that keeps customers coming back.

Live Music & Entertainment

The Trough hosts regular Tuesday night open mic series in June featuring Susan Morgan from Anything But Suzy as opening act then welcoming solo or duo performers. All musical acts welcome that maintain relaxed atmosphere. Susan can accompany performers on guitar if needed. The venue also features other live music performances throughout the year with local musicians. Weekly Trivia Tuesday hosted by server Ayden with happy hour prices from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

Private Events & Catering

The Trough can accommodate private parties up to 60 people in their beautiful space. Full catering services available for off-site events bringing their quality food to your celebration or gathering.

The Olde Dairy Market

Adjacent to the restaurant The Olde Dairy market offers neighborhood convenience including expanded wine and microbrew selections growing selection of local products like Le Petite breads and pastries Montana Coffee Traders coffee fresh produce organic grocery options and ice cream. The complex also includes functioning gas station making it true one-stop neighborhood hub.

Hours & Location

Open Monday through Friday 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Saturday 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM and Sunday 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Located at 2106 Clements Road in the Target Range area of Missoula. Family-friendly environment with something for everyone.
